about.title: Technical profile, data
paragraphs: I am Daniel García Nilo, a Computer Engineer currently working as a Data Analyst at SDG Group. I work in data consulting projects involving analytics, data transformation, visualization and business-oriented data solutions.

My professional background began mainly in Software Engineering, backend, automation and enterprise systems. From October 2024 to May 2026 I worked in the Architecture Department at Grupo Catalana Occident / Occident, evolving corporate solutions linked to AI, internal processes, C#/.NET, SQL, GAAN, JavaScript validations and agile work with JIRA.

I now focus my career on Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. I combine analytics, statistics, visualization, software engineering and AI to turn data into useful information and technology solutions with business context.
